gloss: by some chance, in the unlikely event

definitions.gloss: by some chance, if by any chance
definitions.explanation: Indicates an unlikely but possible scenario.

definitions.gloss: one in ten thousand, remote possibility
definitions.explanation: As a noun, refers to a very unlikely chance or emergency.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}ったら{中止|ちゅうし}です。
examples.english: If by any chance it rains, it will be canceled.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}{遅|おく}れる{場合|ばあい}は{連絡|れんらく}してください。
examples.english: Please contact us if by any chance you're going to be late.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}{火事|かじ}が{起|お}きたら、すぐに{逃|に}げてください。
examples.english: In the unlikely event of a fire, please evacuate immediately.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}に{備|そな}えて{保険|ほけん}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I got insurance in case of emergency.

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}のことがあったら、この{番号|ばんごう}に{電話|でんわ}してください。
examples.english: If anything happens, please call this number.
examples.notes: {万一|まんいち}のこと = emergency, worst case

examples.japanese: {万一|まんいち}の{場合|ばあい}に{備|そな}えて、{非常|ひじょう}{持|も}ち{出|だ}し{袋|ぶくろ}を{用意|ようい}しておこう。
examples.english: Let's prepare an emergency bag in case of the worst.

notes:
Literally means "one in ten thousand" ({万|まん} = 10,000, {一|いち} = 1), suggesting very low probability.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{万一|まんいち}〜たら/〜ば (if by any chance ~)
・{万一|まんいち}の{場合|ばあい} (in the unlikely event)
・{万一|まんいち}のこと (emergency, worst case scenario)
・{万一|まんいち}に{備|そな}えて (in preparation for emergencies)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・もし〜たら (if - general)
・もしも〜たら (if - emphatic)
・{万一|まんいち}〜たら (if by some unlikely chance)
